name: vietnam-pit
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Vietnam personal income tax (thuế thu nhập cá nhân, TNCN) for tax year 2026, for employees, self-employed individuals and household businesses. Trigger on phrases like thuế TNCN, Vietnam income tax, giảm trừ gia cảnh, biểu thuế lũy tiến, PIT Vietnam, personal deduction Vietnam, dependent deduction Vietnam, hộ kinh doanh tax, quyết toán thuế TNCN, or any question about computing or filing personal income tax in Vietnam. Covers the five-band schedule of Law 109/2025/QH15 (5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 35%), the family deductions of VND 15.5 million and 6.2 million a month, the business income regime with the VND 1 billion threshold set by Decree 141/2026, other income, non-residents and the 2026 filing deadlines. Tier 2, not reviewed by an accountant.
